emotional_tone: Professional, authoritative, visionary, yet deeply trustworthy. Blends enterprise reliability with cutting-edge AI product development.

rules: Use #F7F9FB as the global background. Avoid pure white except for elevated cards.
Use Deep Blue (#0B3C5D) for primary CTAs and heavy structural elements (like footer or high-impact bento grids).
Use Teal (#2EC4B6) selectively as a kinetic trigger - for micro-interactions, active states, glowing borders, or 'Tracing Beam' effects.
Ensure text contrast ratios (APCA) are strictly met. Never use Teal for text on light backgrounds without darkening.
No Inter for headings (E1 strictly forbids generic sans for H1-H3). Use Cabinet Grotesk for a premium, authoritative SaaS look.
Body text uses Inter to ensure maximum legibility for data-heavy/SaaS style content, honoring user preference.
H1 (Hero): text-5xl sm:text-6xl with tracking-tight and leading-none. Never exceed text-6xl.
Overlines/Labels: Uppercase, tracking-widest, text-xs. Use Soft Blue or Deep Blue.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Mode A: The 'Tetris' Grid for Marketing. Use bento-style cards for Services and Products sections.
rules: Use p-8 to p-16 for section padding.
Cards must have generous internal padding (p-8) to prevent text collision.
Employ The 'Tetris' Grid (md:grid-cols-8 or 12). Span items across 2, 4, or 6 columns to create asymmetrical tension.
Never perfectly center everything. Use structural grayscale and grid alignments to guide flow.
Hero sections should not be the standard 50/50 split. Consider overlapping the hero text over an abstract AI graphic or dashboard visual.

surface_strategies.cards: Solid background (#FFFFFF) with 1px border (#0B3C5D/10) and subtle shadow-sm. On hover: -translate-y-1, shadow-lg, and border darkens to Soft Blue.
surface_strategies.nav_header: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F7F9FB]/80 with a 1px delicate inner stroke on the bottom.
surface_strategies.high_impact_widgets: Use 'The Tracing Beam' strategy for the primary AI Product showcase card. A subtle glowing teal border.
surface_strategies.footer: Contrast Shift: Footer must be Dark (#0B3C5D) with white/light text and massive spacing (py-24).

components_and_motion.html_tailwind: Use native HTML/Tailwind for large layout structures, asymmetrical bento grids, and overlapping sections.
components_and_motion.shadcn: Use Shadcn components for forms, inputs, buttons, and dialogs. Strip out standard 'Vercel' looks to match the brand.
motion: Staggered entrance animations for bento grids.
Hover states must explicitly set text color (e.g., hover:bg-[#0B3C5D] hover:text-white).
Use lenis for smooth momentum scrolling to add a premium feel.

icons.style: Duotone weight to match the high-end premium B2B aesthetic.

page_structure_instructions.Hero: Dual CTAs (Primary: Deep Blue, Secondary: Outline). Abstract 3D geometric AI graphic overlapping the right side. Headline must be Cabinet Grotesk.
page_structure_instructions.Positioning: Large, confident typography (text-3xl/4xl) in the center with vast negative space. 'More Than a Service Agency'.
page_structure_instructions.Problem_Agitation: Darker section (Deep Blue background) highlighting outdated systems. Use text-white and Soft Blue accents.
page_structure_instructions.Services: Bento 'Tetris' grid. 4 items overlapping. Sharp 1px borders.
page_structure_instructions.Products: Showcase dashboards. Floating UI cards. Use 'Tracing Beam' highlight on the flagship SaaS product.
page_structure_instructions.How_It_Works: 4 steps connected by a subtle SVGs/animated dashed line (Soft Blue to Teal gradient).
page_structure_instructions.Benefits: Focus on metrics. Use Phosphor icons (Duotone) in Teal.
page_structure_instructions.Case_Study: Large high-quality photography of corporate professionals overlapping a data chart.
page_structure_instructions.CTA: Sticky or prominent Lead capture CTA before footer.
page_structure_instructions.Footer: Deep Blue background, generous py-24, structured links.

hero_graphic.description: Abstract blue and dark geometric shapes for the right side of the hero section.

product_dashboards.description: Modern SaaS dashboard UI for the 'Products' showcase section.
Performance analytics on screen for 'Problem/Outdated systems' contrast or 'Benefits'.

case_study.description: Business professionals discussing strategy in a modern office.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='audit-form-submit').
